deploy.//: Railway has no one-shot job primitive, so the migrate service from docker-compose.yml has no equivalent here. preDeployCommand is the platform's stand-in: it runs once per deploy, inside the network where postgres.railway.internal resolves, and the deploy is aborted if it fails. `migrate deploy` is idempotent, so redeploys with no new migrations are a no-op.
deploy.//seed: TEMPORARY: seeds the design's demo content into the deployed database once. Every seed write is an upsert that leaves existing rows alone, but it does re-create rows deleted in the panel, so this line is removed again as soon as it has run.
